test_name: Personnel Security - PS-3 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Claims-Processing-138
Primary NIST family: Personnel Security (PS); evidence focus: PS-3.
Environment: Azure Government. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: a contractor screening renewal is complete but its evidence attachment has not yet synchronized to the case system. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
